name: Skustell
description: Skustell was an humid planet in the Skustell Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Ongree, a bipedal, humpbacked, amphibious sentient species. Even after Skustell became part of galactic society, Ongree were not widely seen away from their homeworld.
lead_paragraphs: Skustell was an humid planet in the Skustell Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Ongree, a bipedal, humpbacked, amphibious sentient species. Even after Skustell became part of galactic society, Ongree were not widely seen away from their homeworld.
During the Old Republic Skustell was rumored that a golden waterfall on the planet hid the entrance of a cave, which contained treasures.
